regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and SI availability sentence
regions.finding: Verified the source title and aggregate reaction claim. The paper mentions online Supporting Information, but workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1 Early reports branches a–c
regions.finding: Four cited prior-work condition variants were classified as literature examples: two hexane-2,5-dione conditions, one divinylbenzene sequence, and one Ru/TFA alkenynol reaction. They are not current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1 This report generic arrow
regions.finding: The indole plus substituted 2,3-allenol to N-H carbazole drawing is a general current reaction class with generic R/R1/R2/R3 groups; experiment-specific rows are represented separately.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right initial acid-screening and gold-cyclization prose
regions.finding: The TsOH·H2O result and other acid screens map to Table 1 entries 1–9; the no-cyclization AuCl(PPh3)-only observation maps to Table 2 entry 1. Narrative mentions were linked rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Scheme 1 prior-work structures/operations are partly generic and were not expanded from cited external papers.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–9, and footnotes
regions.finding: Nine independent acid-screening runs were retained with exact substrate amounts, acid identity/loading, DCE volume, N2/room temperature, row times, crude-1H-NMR 3a yields, recovered 1a yields, and the entry-6 isolated yield. (R)-BNPPA identity from footnote c is structured as a participant.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 header, entries 1–13, and footnotes
regions.finding: Thirteen independent cyclization runs were retained with catalyst substitutions/omissions, loadings, DCE/N2, row time/temperature, product-specific 4a/4a' NMR and isolated yields, and recovered 3a in entries 1 and 6. Zero yields are explicit source values.
A separate DDQ/DMF room-temperature aromatization of crude 4a to 5a reports 84% after 16.7 h; the yield basis and scale are not stated. Figure 1 is X-ray characterization, not another synthesis.
Scope prose introduces Tables 3/4 on page 3. The ORTEP drawing and CCDC-linked characterization support the source assignment of 5a but do not verify a machine structure or create another experiment.

unresolved: Optimization rows omit workup, purification, and isolated masses.
Equation 1 omits absolute scale, solvent volume, workup, purification, mass, and yield basis.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Equation 2 and scope prose
regions.finding: A distinct three-stage 1p/2a sequence gives 3p in 76% (dr 3:2) and 5p in 56%. The equation's missing absolute scale and solvent volumes remain unresolved.

Ten allenol-scope sequences were retained separately with stage-1 and stage-2 times/yields, shared reagent quantities and solvents, and row-specific DDQ times of 12.5 h for entry 3 and 4 h for entry 9.
Five aryl/heteroaryl allenol-scope sequences were retained separately; entries 2/3 use 4.3 h DDQ treatment and entry 4 carries out stage 1 at 50 °C for 130 h.

Equation 3 is represented as two separately charged experimental stages: 1a/2a to isolated 3a, then 3a through Au/Ag cyclization and DDQ aromatization to 5a. Equation 4 is a distinct unpurified three-stage sequence with 47% combined yield from 1a to 5a.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 2 application arrows and Scheme 3 introduction
regions.finding: The 5a→5aa→5ab two-stage sequence preserves 93%/90% stage yields and the text's 84% two-step yield; three separate 5ab coupling arrows give 5ac/5ad/5ae. Scheme 3 is classified as a proposed mechanism.

unresolved: Most scope rows omit workup, purification, isolated masses, and the DDQ-stage atmosphere.
The Scheme 2 warming transition from -78 °C to -20 °C has no reported duration.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 5 entries 1–7 and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven indole-scope sequences were retained with shared charges and three ordered stages, row-specific times/yields, 5.5 h DDQ treatment in entry 2, and 50 °C stage-1 reaction in entry 5.

regions.region: page 4 Equation 3/4 drawings and Experimental Section preparation of 3a
regions.finding: The exact 6 mmol 1a/9 mmol 2a preparation, N2/room-temperature 13 h hold, silica filtration, chromatography, 1.4958 g mass, and 75% isolated yield enrich the Equation 3 stage-1 record rather than creating a duplicate. Equation 4 remains separate.

The image was read arrow by arrow: BBr3 addition/hold/warming and Tf2O triflation are ordered stages, while three downstream cross-couplings are independent experiments with distinct reagents, atmospheres, temperatures, times, and yields.
IM1, IM2, IM3, and IM3' are proposed intermediates leading to 4a/4a' and are not isolated experiment records. Table 2 already retains the measured product ratios/yields.

unresolved: Scheme 2 lacks absolute scale, solvent volumes, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
The BBr3 warming-transition time is not reported.
Proposed mechanism intermediates are not independently observed or quantified.

regions.finding: Spectroscopic characterization completes the page-4 gram-scale 3a preparation; it does not define another reaction or yield.

The existing Equation 3 stage-2 record was enriched with a 0 °C/10 min precooling step, exact catalyst charges, 0 °C/17 h cyclization, silica filtration, DDQ/DMF room-temperature/5 h oxidation, water quench/extraction/washes/drying, chromatography, 1.0039 g/76%, and 124.7–125.7 °C melting point.
Wu Fan is thanked for reproducing Table 3 entry 5 and Table 4 entry 1. No independent quantities, conditions, outcomes, or run identifiers are supplied, so no duplicate experiments were created.
Bibliography is prior-literature context. CCDC 1002420 characterizes 5a but is not a new preparation, not treated as an associated workspace SI file, and not machine-structure verification.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment does not define separable runs.
The detailed 5a paragraph does not explicitly state an atmosphere for each stage.
CCDC 1002420 is crystallographic data rather than an explicitly associated workspace SI file.
